European car companies, especially German ones, offer high quality, but there is a problem! When you buy a car, the company does not give you all the features that should be available, but sells them to you through subscriptions, and this is unfortunate. For this reason, China understood this loophole and exploited it, and today it offers competitive cars with all the basic features, adding other features for free in order to attract customers. Today we see a wide spread of Chinese cars with European quality and a lower price, perhaps less than 50% of the price of a European cars, with so many features.
